name: nocturne
title: Nocturne
character: The page is a place at a particular hour: a layered drawn landscape under one moon or sun opens the site, and the sky's colour, lit windows and horizon lines carry on down the page.
suits: guided tours, night walks and boat trips
restaurants and bars, especially evening ones
the launch of a game or a book
notFor: shops that sell from a catalogue
signature: The scene kit: SVG symbols (horizons, subjects, sky parts) composed with <use> into a layered first-screen landscape lit by one light source, with stars generated by pack.js and a live 'tonight' status line worked out from a list of dates and a decision time.
